Eventually, he had trained this one skill to such an extreme that he could snap a thousand branches with it. However, no matter how hard he tried, he couldn’t get the desired result, he couldn’t learn any new skills required to become a real adventurer. It may be time to let go of his dream. But he couldn’t. Not just yet. Knowing this, he returned to the capital again. This was a man of endless dedication, a man who used that dedication to become one of the strongest in the world. title: Ares
titleNative: 떠돌이 용병 아레스
synopsis: After more than 200 years, the kingdom Chronos is declining. Ten years of peace undermined the army and in the country, formerly called the "Land of the Sword", is left with nothing but old heroes. In the south and east, two major kingdoms threaten Chronos. Silonika Isiris in the west is, too, gaining momentum with the smaller states, united under the Radinka Alliance. In addition, King Chronos apparently begins to lose his mind... In these challenging times Chronos's only hope lies in their mercenaries, among whom just came a new addition: the young, but incredibly skilled warrior Ares and his friends, Michael and Baron.

synopsis: Here's the sweet, bloody yakuza love story we've all been waiting for!
